text: Implemented DType.format across the closed dtype family and routed NDArray/BorrowedNDArray previews through it. UInt8/UInt16 now render logical magnitudes; Float/Double explicitly preserve NaN, infinities, and signed zero across JVM/Scala.js. Unary plus remains an eager owned copy and is now documented and tested for owned, borrowed, and mutable inputs. Evidence: BorrowedEqualitySuite 9/9 on JVM and JS; JvmBorrowedOwnershipSuite 5/5; JsBorrowedOwnershipSuite 5/5; full coreJVM 204/204; full coreJS 197/197; fmtCheck passed; docsCheck with 19 mdoc files passed.
